Findings:  No knee joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Small 12 mm x 9 mm x 12 mm intramedullary lobulated lesion in the distal femoral metaphysis. The lesion returns low signal T1, bright on fluid sensitive sequences and contains a number of hypointense foci on all sequences in keeping with calcifications. No infiltration into the bone cortex or extraosseous spread. No surrounding marrow edema. Findings represent an incidental chondroid lesion with no aggressive features.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments. Intact menisci.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  Intact quadriceps and patellar tendons. No evidence of fat pad impingement. Prominent degenerative changes along the median patellar ridge and medial retropatellar facet with focal full-thickness chondral loss and prominent underlying bone stress changes. Normal patella tendon ratio and TTâ€“TG. Normal trochlear depth and lateral trochlear inclination.  Well-maintained medial and lateral tibiofemoral hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Prominent patellofemoral compartment degenerative changes as described above. Incidental distal femoral metaphyseal chondroid lesion with no aggressive features.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior, posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Medial menisküste belirgin hacim kaybı izlenmekte olup gövde kesimi izlenmemiştir. Anterior ve posterior hornlarında ise grade III dejenerasyonlar izlenmiştir.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyona sekonder kalınlaşma ve sinyal artışı izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellada süperior kesiminde kontüzyonel kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiştir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu femur medial kondilde subkondral fokal kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiştir. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda bütünlük kaybı izlenmiştir. TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Healing non-displaced fracture along the medial patella. Osseous remodeling at the origin of the medial gastrocnemius. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the posterior weightbearing medial femoral condyle. Full-thickness fissuring at the high posterior nonweightbearing medial femoral condyle with subchondral marrow edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Inner margin blunting of the lateral meniscus body.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage loss along the posterior high nonweightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss overlying the medial patellar facet and median ridge. Full-thickness cartilage loss along the central and medial trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Both bundles intact. Small internal ganglion cyst likely sequela of prior sprain. 
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Healing non-displaced fracture along the medial patella.
2.	Inner margin blunting of the lateral meniscus body.
3.	Tricompartmental chondrosis, severe in the patellofemoral compartment and moderate in the medial compartment.
